COMPUTED STATISTICAL FINDINGS (do not recompute — narrate only):

PERIOD ANALYSED: 2025-11-18 to 2026-11-18

LONGER LOOK-BACK: the chosen period holds too few observations for a trend for Food insecurity (IPC 3+, % of the analysed population) (1 observation); its trend is computed over 2021-11-18 to 2026-11-18.

## Food security: people in need — Latest Values
The chosen period 2025-11-18 to 2026-11-18 holds 1 observation, so the values cover the longer look-back 2021-11-18 to 2026-11-18. Food security: people in need: 3 observations from 2024-01-01 to 2026-01-01 — too few for a trend test (at least 4 are needed), so no trend or statistical test is reported. Values: 2024-01-01 15800000 people; 2025-01-01 14800000 people; 2026-01-01 17400000 people. Latest value as of the chosen period: 17400000 people (2026-01-01).

## Nutrition: people in need — Latest Values
The chosen period 2025-11-18 to 2026-11-18 holds 1 observation, so the values cover the longer look-back 2021-11-18 to 2026-11-18. Nutrition: people in need: 3 observations from 2024-01-01 to 2026-01-01 — too few for a trend test (at least 4 are needed), so no trend or statistical test is reported. Values: 2024-01-01 7400000 people; 2025-01-01 7800000 people; 2026-01-01 7460000 people. Latest value as of the chosen period: 7460000 people (2026-01-01).

## Food insecurity (IPC 3+, % of the analysed population) — Trend Analysis
Look-back: the chosen period 2025-11-18 to 2026-11-18 holds 1 observation, too few for a trend test, so the trend is computed over 2021-11-18 to 2026-11-18. Latest value as of the chosen period: 32.0% (2026-09-01). Trend over the look-back — Food insecurity (IPC 3+, % of the analysed population): direction=decreasing, Sen slope=-4.65 percentage points per year (95% CI -7.99 to 0), Kendall tau=-0.53, Mann-Kendall p=0.059, Holm-adjusted p=0.059 → NOT SIGNIFICANT (α=0.05), change along the trend line 2022-03-01 → 2026-09-01=-21.0 percentage points, observed first value 47.0% (2022-03-01), latest value 32.0% (2026-09-01), n=9.

DATA GAPS:
- Food security: people in need: trend için yetersiz veri (n=3)
- Nutrition: people in need: trend için yetersiz veri (n=3)

DATA NOTES:
- Food insecurity (IPC 3+, % of the analysed population) (trend look-back 2021-11-18 to 2026-11-18): IPC analyses covered different parts of the country in different periods (analysed population 41.4 to 49.7 million), so the share of the analysed population is used, not the number of people

METHOD NOTES:
- Trend: Mann-Kendall test; the slope is Sen's slope per year on the real dates of the periods; Kendall tau is the effect size.
- Regions: Kruskal-Wallis test across admin-1 regions.
- Correlation: Pearson, only for indicator pairs with at least 8 common periods.
- Multiple comparisons: Holm correction across all 1 tests in this report; significance is decided on the Holm-adjusted p-value at α=0.05.
- Limitation: the series are short; the tests assume independent observations and serial correlation between consecutive periods is not corrected for, so the results are indicative.

PERIOD ANALYSED: 2025-11-18 to 2026-11-18

## Protection: people in need — Latest Values
The chosen period 2025-11-18 to 2026-11-18 holds 1 observation, so the values cover the longer look-back 2021-11-18 to 2026-11-18. Protection: people in need: 3 observations from 2024-01-01 to 2026-01-01 — the values are not comparable across years (2024, 2025: possibly one of the plan's separate protection lines rather than its overall figure; 2026: the plan's only protection figure; HDX HAPI does not say which line each year's figure is), so no trend or statistical test is reported. Values: 2024-01-01 14800000 people; 2025-01-01 14200000 people; 2026-01-01 15000000 people. Latest value as of the chosen period: 15000000 people (2026-01-01).

Latest value before the chosen period: 2670000 people (2025-01-01). Trend over the look-back — Refugees (people): direction=decreasing, Sen slope=-817000 per year (95% CI: too few points), Kendall tau=-0.33, Mann-Kendall p=0.734, Holm-adjusted p=0.734 → NOT SIGNIFICANT (α=0.05), relative change along the trend line 2022-01-01 → 2025-01-01=-38.1%, observed first value 5660000 people (2022-01-01), latest value 2670000 people (2025-01-01), n=4.

## Internally displaced people (IDPs) — Latest Values

Internally displaced people (IDPs): 3 observations from 2025-01-31 to 2026-01-31 — too few for a trend test (at least 4 are needed), so no trend or statistical test is reported. - Internally displaced people (IDPs) (trend look-back 2021-11-18 to 2026-11-18): only the DTM operation 'Climate and mobility in Afghanistan' is used; 1 other operation(s) count displacement differently and are not mixed in

- Trend: Mann-Kendall test; the slope is Sen's slope per year on the real dates of the periods; Kendall tau is the effect size.

- Correlation: Pearson, only for indicator pairs with at least 8 common periods.
- Multiple comparisons: Holm correction across all 2 tests in this report; significance is decided on the Holm-adjusted p-value at α=0.05.
